create_tensorboard_logger: create a TensorboardLogger instance to log training metrics to tensorboard with a custom log directory
log_metrics_tensorboard: log training or validation metrics to tensorboard using the TensorboardLogger log_metrics method
create_wandb_logger: create a WandbLogger instance to log metrics and model artifacts to Weights and Biases
log_model_wandb: log model files, vocab, and training stats as artifacts to W&B using the log_model method
create_clearml_logger: create a ClearMLLogger instance to log metrics and debug samples to ClearML WebUI
